scenarios.setup: Submit task.json (workspace filled at submit); run generate→review; archive result per delivery contract.
scenarios.expected: Independent review pass; both trusted criteria pass with evidence; succeeded; no target files touched.

scenarios.setup: First model output swaps the first two records (injected deviation, recorded with before/after hashes at run time, mirroring the E3 pattern).
scenarios.expected: Reviewer revises with evidence; bounded repair restores order; re-review passes; v1/v2 artifacts and both bindings retained; succeeded.

scenarios.setup: Submit with max_turns=1 and a reviewer that always revises.
scenarios.expected: Terminal failed with a budget reason code; never succeeded; partial artifacts retained and queryable.

scenarios.setup: Worker adapter unavailable (fault injection offline; real outage if observed).
scenarios.expected: Controlled stop without success; error names the unavailable role; no invented artifact.

scenarios.setup: Worker returns non-JSON content for the artifact.
scenarios.expected: Acceptance content check fails closed (unparseable note); task cannot succeed on this turn.

scenarios.setup: Cancel a non-terminal task via CLI.
scenarios.expected: Status cancelled with reason; later queries show the terminal state.

scenarios.setup: Task flagged with an unconfirmed side effect before success evaluation.
scenarios.expected: Success gate blocks; needs_attention with explicit reconciliation steps; no silent success.
